scenarios.name: Three cold starts and multi-turn use
procedure: Start only the approved Haven-managed provider from a confirmed stopped state.
Run a bounded multi-turn Chat, Writing, and Summarization sequence without retaining content.
Record first-token latency, throughput, memory, accelerator residency, and bounded error codes.
Unload the exact model and stop only processes bound to the current Haven process receipt.
passCriteria: All three cold starts become ready within the declared timeout.
Every capability completes and retains no prompt or response.
Every attempt unloads the model and closes the managed listener and processes.

scenarios.name: Cancellation and exact cleanup
procedure: Start a bounded long response using the exact approved model.
Cancel through Haven's request-specific cancellation path.
Verify one terminal cancellation result and discard partial content.
Unload the model and verify the receipt-bound process and listener cleanup.
passCriteria: Cancellation affects only the active request and produces one bounded terminal result.
No partial content, managed listener, loaded model, or receipt-bound child process remains.

scenarios.name: Unload and reload
procedure: Complete one bounded request and unload the exact model.
Verify zero residency for that model.
Reload the same digest and complete the next bounded request.
Repeat without downloading, deleting, or changing model selection.
passCriteria: Every unload is independently observed before reload.
Every reload uses the same model digest and the requested accelerator.
No stale model or provider process remains after final cleanup.

scenarios.name: Runtime restart and provider failure recovery
procedure: Record the exact managed provider process receipt and stop only that process.
Confirm Haven reports a bounded provider-unavailable error without losing the unsent prompt.
Restart the approved provider and verify the same runtime version and model digest.
Run one bounded recovery request, then unload and clean up.
passCriteria: The failure is visible and bounded rather than silently falling back.
Recovery uses the same provider version, model digest, and accelerator path.
No stale listener or duplicate provider survives.

scenarios.name: Interrupted download recovery
procedure: Use only a separately approved disposable managed-data root and exact reviewed artifact.
Interrupt the request through the test transport after a recorded byte boundary.
Verify partial data remains quarantined and cannot be selected as an installed model.
Retry through the normal verified path and require exact size and digest before admission.
passCriteria: Interrupted bytes are never treated as installed or executable.
Retry either resumes safely or restarts clearly and ends with the exact verified digest.
Cleanup removes only disposable test data named in the execution receipt.

scenarios.name: Bounded low-memory and low-disk recovery
procedure: Run inside an approved job, cgroup, VM, or equivalent memory limit with host headroom preserved.
Use a quota-limited disposable directory to simulate low disk without filling a real filesystem.
Verify setup and inference stop with specific recoverable errors.
Release the limits, retry once, then unload and clean up receipt-bound resources.
passCriteria: The host retains its declared memory and storage safety floor.
No real filesystem is filled and no unrelated process is pressured.
Haven reports bounded low-resource errors and succeeds after the constraint is removed.

scenarios.name: Sleep and wake recovery
procedure: Confirm the operating system and hardware support a controlled sleep test.
Require an operator-present approval immediately before each power transition.
Enter sleep with no active model response and then resume.
Verify connection state, run one bounded request, unload, and clean up.
passCriteria: Resume does not create a duplicate provider or stale listener.
Haven either reconnects safely or presents a clear retry path.
Post-resume inference uses the same model digest and accelerator.

scenarios.name: Concurrent system load and final cleanup
procedure: Start a bounded synthetic load with declared CPU, memory, duration, and temperature stops.
Run the fixed Chat, Writing, and Summarization checks while recording latency and throughput.
Stop the synthetic load through its exact receipt.
Close Haven and verify model unload, listener closure, and exact managed-process cleanup.
passCriteria: The model remains accelerated and produces bounded results without unsafe temperature or memory pressure.
Performance degradation is recorded rather than hidden.
No synthetic-load, provider, model, listener, or Haven-owned child process remains.

universalStopConditions: temperature, power, driver, filesystem, or operating-system warning
private content or machine identity entering evidence
